description: Returns information of the block matching the given block hash.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: The hash (32 bytes) of the block

parameters.name: transaction_detail_flag
parameters.description: It returns the full transaction objects when it is true otherwise it returns only the hashes of the transactions

object.description: A block object, or null when no block was found

object.baseFeePerGas.description: A string of the base fee encoded in hexadecimal format. Please note that this response field will not be included in a block requested before the EIP-1559 upgrade

object.difficulty.description: The integer of the difficulty for this block encoded as a hexadecimal

object.extraData.description: The “extra data” field of this block

object.gasLimit.description: The maximum gas allowed in this block encoded as a hexadecimal

object.gasUsed.description: The total used gas by all transactions in this block encoded as a hexadecimal

object.hash.description: The block hash of the requested block. null if pending

object.logsBloom.description: The bloom filter for the logs of the block. null if pending

object.miner.description: The address of the beneficiary to whom the mining rewards were given

object.mixHash.description: A string of a 256-bit hash encoded as a hexadecimal

object.nonce.description: The hash of the generated proof-of-work. null if pending

object.number.description: The block number of the requested block encoded as a hexadecimal. null if pending

object.parentHash.description: The hash of the parent block

object.receiptsRoot.description: The root of the receipts trie of the block

object.sha3Uncles.description: The SHA3 of the uncles data in the block

object.size.description: The size of this block in bytes as an Integer value encoded as hexadecimal

object.stateRoot.description: The root of the final state trie of the block

object.timestamp.description: The unix timestamp for when the block was collated

object.transactions.description: An array of transaction objects - please see eth_getTransactionByHash for exact shape

object.transactionsRoot.description: The root of the transaction trie of the block

object.withdrawals.description: A withdrawals object contains information about withdrawals made by validators. Please note that this field will not be included in a block requested before the EIP-4895 upgrade

object.withdrawals.index.description: The index of the withdrawal to uniquely identify each withdrawal

object.withdrawals.validatorIndex.description: The index of the validator who initiated the withdrawal

object.withdrawals.address.description: The address to which the withdrawn amount is sent

object.withdrawals.amount.description: The amount of ether, provided in hexadecimal format, corresponding to a certain value in gwei

object.withdrawalsRoot.description: The Merkle root of withdrawal data. Also, please note that this field will not be included in a block requested before the EIP-4895 upgrade
